[USER] The user is seeking recommendations for good LED bulbs for their laundry room.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended the following LED bulbs for the laundry room:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. LIFX LED bulbs (smart bulbs, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth control, adjustable brightness and color temperature).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Cree LED bulbs (affordable, lifespan up to 25,000 hours, available in various color temperatures including daylight 5000K).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Sylvania Smart+ LED bulbs (features include scheduling, remote control, color temperature adjustment, compatible with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised the user to consider lumen output (800-1000 lumens), color temperature (warm white 2700K-3000K or daylight 5000K), dimming capability, and Energy Star certification when choosing an LED bulb.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained the difference between warm white and daylight color temperatures:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Warm White (2700K-3000K): Soft, cozy, yellowish light, similar to incandescent bulbs, used in relaxing spaces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Daylight (5000K-6500K): Bright, neutral, bluish light, similar to natural daylight, ideal for task areas like laundry rooms.
